description: Single virtual position from a PinePort trade plan (Price Action MTF by default). Plan SL and target only; no order API.

assumptions.symbol: XAUUSDm: point 0.001, 3 digits, measured spread ~260 points; spread cap 600 points
assumptions.entry: simulated fill at ask/bid plus adverse slippage; the plan entry is a reference only
assumptions.commission: total cash per fill, charged on open and close
assumptions.slippage: points, adverse on every fill including stop fills
assumptions.target_fill: the target price is used as the fill; favourable gaps are not credited
assumptions.indicator: iCustom with the indicator's default inputs except the rr bridge (InpPaRr1, InpPaRrMin), which the EA forwards to open or close the plan gate
